faq.q: What is the origin of Aazam?
faq.a: The recorded form أعظم is Arabic and is related to the adjective عظيم.
Yes. The recorded Arabic form is أعظم (aʿẓam).

faq.q: What is the root of Aazam?
faq.a: The form is related to the Arabic root ع ظ م (ʿ-ẓ-m), associated with greatness.
Aazam is used as a personal name in Muslim communities, but the lexical form is not an exclusively religious title.
This record does not establish Aazam as a Qur'anic personal name; Arabic origin alone is not proof of scriptural status.
